plugin-skill-contribution.note: A plugin ships skills under skills/ and the loader registers them.

plugin-command-contribution.note: A plugin ships slash commands under commands/ and the loader registers them.

implicit-skill-suppression.note: Skill frontmatter disable-model-invocation keeps a skill out of automatic selection.

structured-question.note: The interactive ask tool returns the option the human picked.

suspended-turn-ask.note: Not needed. The interactive ask tool already collects an answer mid-turn.

hook-ask.note: A hook returning ask shows the human a permission prompt.

hook-deny.note: A hook returning deny stops the tool call.

per-seat-tool-allowlist.note: An agent definition's tools frontmatter fixes the tool list for that seat.

agent-depth-limit.note: A leaf seat's agent def omits the Agent tool (flow:implementer, Explore), so nesting is impossible rather than discouraged.

per-seat-authority-narrowing.note: An agent def's tools list narrows each seat below the session (Explore has no Edit/Write/Agent; flow:implementer has no Agent); neither host has a per-seat filesystem sandbox.

skill-composition.note: The Skill tool loads a named skill mid-turn.

mcp-client-roots.note: The MCP client advertises the roots capability and answers roots/list with the session workspace.

hooks-in-native-children.note: A subagent's tool calls run the session's PreToolUse hooks.

plugin-skill-contribution.note: Live probe: Codex discovers a plugin's skills with no extra configuration.

plugin-command-contribution.note: Live probe: Codex did not discover a plugin's commands/ directory.

implicit-skill-suppression.note: The 0.151.0 source honors allow_implicit_invocation, but nothing proves the plugin-loader path reaches that code. A live capture of a plugin-supplied agents/openai.yaml staying out of automatic selection flips this to true.

structured-question.note: No interactive question tool that returns a chosen option.

suspended-turn-ask.note: The turn ends with the question and the human answers in the next turn. The platform sends no receipt, so the protocol is the whole assurance.

hook-ask.note: Codex 0.151.0 accepts an ask decision and then fails open, running the command with no prompt. false is the honest value.

hook-deny.note: A hook returning deny stops the tool call.

agent-depth-limit.note: agents.max_depth is V1-only and ignored by multi-agent V2 (codex-rs/core/src/config/mod.rs:882); the V2 spawn path (agent/control/spawn.rs) has no depth check, so a descendant-spawn prohibition is prompt contract only.

per-seat-authority-narrowing.note: V2 spawn_agent accepts only model, reasoning_effort and fork_turns (tools/handlers/multi_agents_spec.rs); a child inherits the parent's cwd, approval policy and sandbox.

skill-composition.note: No Skill-call tool; a skill composes by reading its sibling SKILL.md files as its own text instructs. Verified on the installed-plugin path by the slice 3 Codex prep capture (flow-evidence pr-9/capture-prep-codex.txt): grill-with-docs loaded ../grilling/SKILL.md and ../domain-modeling/SKILL.md and ran the grill under them.

mcp-client-roots.note: The Codex 0.151.0 MCP client advertises no roots capability and sets no project-dir variable; the delegation server takes the launch shell PWD as the workspace boundary on this host, so a session started with codex -C elsewhere fails closed with OUTSIDE_ROOTS.

hooks-in-native-children.note: A V2 child receives a Config derived from the parent's turn (agent/control/spawn.rs) and the plugin PreToolUse hooks fire inside it: a spawn_agent child attempting an unsanctioned issue create and a git push --no-verify was denied by both flow guards (slice 3 capture, flow-evidence pr-9/capture-child-hooks.*).
